# AllYonoPatti

> AllYonoPatti (allyonopatti.com) is an independent, informational Teen Patti category guide: the game's rules, hand rankings, terminology, and variants explained from scratch, plus an honestly-labelled directory of card/casual apps in the wider ecosystem — only some of which document an actual Teen Patti table or mode. It is not a gambling operator, does not run or host any game, and is not affiliated with any app or platform it describes.

Every platform listing carries a status label; anything unconfirmed is marked as awaiting verification rather than guessed. Promo codes are shown only when supplied and verified for that day — never invented. Final safety, legality, and account checks always belong to the reader and the platform operator, not this site.

## Learn Teen Patti

- [Teen Patti rules, step by step](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-rules): boot, blind and seen, chaal, sideshow, and show — a full round in order
- [Hand rankings](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-hand-rankings): trail, pure sequence, sequence, colour, pair, high card, and how ties break
- [Terminology](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-terms): blind, chaal, pack, show, sideshow glossary
- [Common variants](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/common-teen-patti-variations): Muflis, AK47, joker rounds, Best of Four, 999
- [Teen Patti vs poker](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-vs-poker): what's actually different, point by point
- [Teen Patti sequence guide](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-sequence-guide): how runs and pure runs work
- [Teen Patti in Hindi](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/teen-patti-in-hindi): terms in Hindi and English side by side
- [What is Teen Patti?](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/what-is-teen-patti): beginner-friendly explanation

## Safety and legal context

- [How to review a Teen Patti platform safely](https://allyonopatti.com/guides/how-to-review-a-teen-patti-platform-safely): a five-step checklist before installing any app
- [Gambling awareness](https://allyonopatti.com/gambling-awareness): age restrictions, warning signs, and where to find support
- [Legalities overview](https://allyonopatti.com/legalities): how online real-money gaming is regulated in India, state by state

## Directory

- [Platforms with a documented Teen Patti offering](https://allyonopatti.com/games): filtered to apps whose own description names a Teen Patti table or mode
